claim: Registering the same Work Item and record digest with a different label or commit silently overwrote the first provenance.
evidence: The registry filename was derived only from Work Item and digest.
A conflicting second registration previously returned success.
impact: Audit metadata could be silently replaced for the same immutable record set.
required_action: Make identical registration idempotent and reject conflicting provenance atomically.

prevention.action: Registry entries use an atomic create-once file and compare canonical provenance before accepting an existing entry.
